verdict.rationale: Sumsub publishes an API reference section (docs.sumsub.com/reference) for its RESTful API, and a Sandbox mode lets developers test integrations before going live. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and probes for a public OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
